'''Gormel Kenobi''' was a [[Gender/Legends|man]] briefly employed by [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] [[Moisture farmer/Legends|moisture farmer]] [[Wyle Ulbreck]] at some point before [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]]. Ulbreck became convinced Kenobi was a [[Spice/Legends|spice]] addict and a thief, and fired him &mdash; the old farmer was known for believing most people he dealt with were stealing from him. When [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Ben Kenobi's]] surname became known in the [[Pika Oasis/Legends|Pika Oasis]], Ulbreck mentioned Gormel as a Kenobi he had once known.
